subject: MICAR and MPCAR models on Nimble

messages.author: 35cf403e5052bfe0
messages.subject: MICAR and MPCAR models on Nimble
parts:
For those interested in multivariate CAR modeling on Nimble:
as you may be aware Nimble does not currently have the equivalent to the mv.car distribution
which is available on Win/OpenBUGS. This distribution is an implementation of the multivariate ICAR
(MICAR), and it is the only MCAR distribution so far available.

On Nimble, the univariate ICAR and PCAR models are available (as in BUGS) . The linear model of coregionalisation (LMC)
allows the construction of MCAR models from combinations of univariate ICAR and PCAR distributions. As Nimble allows the
use of Cholesky decomposition it is possible to hand code both the MICAR and MPCAR models directly.

This has now been done and benchmark tests demonstrate that even without the conjugate Wishart sampling in the mv.car in BUGS ,
the Nimble implimentation of MICAR (the equivalent to mv.car) is marginally faster in execution, for the same data, than mv.car.
One major advantage of the the Nimble implementation of LMC is that the MPCAR can also be computed and so individual spatial correlation parameters can be estimated for each disease, as well as cross correlations. The MPCAR is not available on Win/OpenBUGS.

Code for both models for the Georgia county level 3 disease example is attached here

There is also a new dedicated GitHub repository for Nimble Bayesian Disease Mapping code here:

https://github.com/Andrew9Lawson/Bayesian_DM_Nimble_code

Thanks also to Chris Paciorek for fixing bugs in the original Nimble code.

Andrew
